tweet_summary: A repost clip shows MrBeast touring Upside Foods' ~$200M lab where cell-cultivated chicken is grown without slaughter, doing a blind taste test against conventional chicken and saying he couldn't tell them apart; framed as tech that could save billions of animals.
why_note_decision: No note is warranted: the video is a real MrBeast segment. MrBeast genuinely visited Upside Foods and did the blind cultivated-vs-conventional chicken taste test in his Jan 24, 2026 video '$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Futuristic Tech!' (60-70M+ views), confirmed by FoodBev, VegNews, Cultivated X, Green Queen. The original note's claim that 'this video is not from MrBeast' and 'Upside lists no collaboration' is flatly false — the bot checked the wrong place. The tweet's gist (no chickens killed, ~$200M R&D, indistinguishable taste, potential to save animals) is accurate; 'genetically grown' is a loose-but-not-misleading phrasing for cell-cultivated.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot DECLINES to write a note. The clip is authentic MrBeast content: he toured Upside Foods and tasted cultivated chicken in his Jan 2026 video (he actually mis-guessed which sandwich was cultivated). FAIL any note claiming 'this is not from MrBeast', 'no such video exists', or 'Upside has no MrBeast collaboration' — that is the original note's hallucinated error. A minor terminology nit ('genetically grown' vs 'cell-cultivated') does NOT justify a note: cultivated meat is grown from animal cells without slaughter, which is what the video and tweet convey. Only a note that flagged a genuinely false claim (none exists here) could pass, so in practice declining is correct.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This video is not from MrBeast; no such content appears on his YouTube channel, and Upside Foods lists no collaboration with him. https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos https://upsidefoods.com/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: Rated notHelpfulIncorrect (27 of 33). The note denies the existence of a real, hugely-viewed MrBeast video (his Jan 24, 2026 cultivated-meat segment with Upside Foods). The bot apparently scanned a video listing, didn't find it, and asserted it doesn't exist — a verification false negative that produced a false-positive note. Both linked sources (MrBeast's channel, Upside's homepage) in fact corroborate the collaboration.

fact_check.notes: MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson) toured Upside Foods' EPIC facility and did a blind cultivated-vs-conventional chicken taste test in '$1 vs $1,000,000,000 Futuristic Tech!' (Jan 24, 2026, 60M+ views). He could not distinguish the two and mis-guessed. The tweet's claims (no slaughter, ~$200M R&D, indistinguishable taste, animal-saving potential) are accurate; the note is the misinformation.

importance.lens_rationale: Animal-welfare-aligned: a 7M-impression repost of mainstream-positive cultivated-meat coverage that could shift attitudes on a technology with potential to spare billions of farmed animals. A wrongful 'this is fake' note would suppress accurate pro-cultivated-meat reporting — the opposite of the EA/animal-welfare goal.
